named-query.name: Product.findByCategoria
named-query.query: SELECT DISTINCT p FROM Product p JOIN p.categorias c WHERE c = :categoria ORDER BY p.nombre

named-query.name: Product.findByCategoriaOrderByPrecioAsc
named-query.query: SELECT DISTINCT p FROM Product p JOIN p.categorias c WHERE c = :categoria ORDER BY p.precio ASC

named-query.name: Product.findByCategoriaOrderByPrecioDesc
named-query.query: SELECT DISTINCT p FROM Product p JOIN p.categorias c WHERE c = :categoria ORDER BY p.precio DESC

named-query.name: Product.findByCategoriaOrderByVentasDesc
named-query.query: SELECT DISTINCT p FROM Product p JOIN p.categorias c WHERE c = :categoria ORDER BY p.ventas DESC

named-query.name: Product.findByCategorias
named-query.query: SELECT DISTINCT p FROM Product p JOIN p.categorias c WHERE c IN (:categorias) ORDER BY p.nombre

named-query.name: Product.findByCategoriasOrderByPrecioAsc
named-query.query: SELECT DISTINCT p FROM Product p JOIN p.categorias c WHERE c IN (:categorias) ORDER BY p.precio ASC

named-query.name: Product.findByCategoriasOrderByPrecioDesc
named-query.query: SELECT DISTINCT p FROM Product p JOIN p.categorias c WHERE c IN (:categorias) ORDER BY p.precio DESC

named-query.name: Product.findByCategoriasOrderByVentasDesc
named-query.query: SELECT DISTINCT p FROM Product p JOIN p.categorias c WHERE c IN (:categorias) ORDER BY p.ventas DESC

named-query.name: Product.findAllCategorias
named-query.query: SELECT DISTINCT c FROM Product p JOIN p.categorias c ORDER BY c
